caption: Cross-section of a MMIC: the semi-insulating GaAs substrate carries the metal 1 interconnect, a passivation dielectric, and a plated airbridge across the top. Notice that the airbridge crosses the surface with air underneath it, which keeps its capacitance to the circuit small.

spec.aria: A five-layer stack, top to bottom: airbridge top metal, passivation dielectric, metal 1 interconnect, GaAs substrate and bottom ground metal.
